description: Review rubric for career-profile records (per-career profile: branch, salary, trajectory, employers, growth).

criteria.label: Factual currency
criteria.description: Salary + employer + growth numbers are recent (within 12 months) and cite-able to a public source.

criteria.label: Indian market relevance
criteria.description: Numbers + employers + paths reflect Indian market reality, not global / US-centric. Salary in INR, employers Indian or with Indian presence.

criteria.label: Honesty about uncertainty
criteria.description: Where data is sparse or projection-heavy (5yr trajectory, 'growth outlook'), the uncertainty is stated, not papered over.

criteria.label: No misleading aspiration
criteria.description: Does not over-sell. A career profile that says 'every NIT CSE grad earns 50LPA' is misleading; one that gives ranges with median + percentiles is honest.

criteria.label: Actionable for student
criteria.description: Student can answer: 'what should I do this year to make this career path possible?'

approval_rule: indian_market_relevance + no_misleading_aspiration MUST be 5/5. Career counselor sign-off + alumni cross-check required.
